audit.whatIsWrong: win[] and phases[].side gave Gwen levels 1, 2 and 3 and marked first item even, contradicting whys[0], whys[1], whys[2] and whys[5].
audit.why: Illaoi out-stats an item-less Gwen and a landed Test of Spirit plus tentacles ends the trade; Gwen does not flip it until Hallowed Mist and Needlework are online at 6, which whys[4] says outright.
audit.corrected: Illaoi / Illaoi / Skill / Skill / Gwen / Gwen / Gwen.

audit.whatIsWrong: Harsh Lesson (W) and Leap of Faith's grounding are absent from the entire page.
audit.why: Harsh Lesson carries dash and autoReset on a 4s cooldown, so 'stay spaced so you never give her a clean Test of Spirit' is only half the plan - she closes the space herself every four seconds, and the reset wind-up is the tell. Leap of Faith carries grounding, untargetable and zone: while her ult is up your Skip 'n Slash is disabled, so you cannot dash out of the tentacle field the page tells you to disengage from. Spend E before she ults, never after.
audit.corrected: early and wants.foe[1] now name Harsh Lesson as her 4s dash-and-reset; mid and late state that Leap of Faith grounds your dash.

audit.whatIsWrong: 'Only commit when her E is down' with no cooldown attached.
audit.why: Test of Spirit is 16/15/14/13/12 and Leap of Faith 120/95/70, against Skip 'n Slash at 13s and Hallowed Mist at 22s. A 16-second E means one dodged Test of Spirit genuinely buys you a full trade window, which is the difference between the page's advice being usable and being a mood.
audit.corrected: whys[2], early and wants.you[0] now carry the numbers.

edits.before: Levels 1-3 are hers and you have to respect it — Illaoi out-stats you on raw base damage, and a landed E (Test of Spirit) rips your spirit out so tentacles spawn and chase you while you have no W and no items to soak the hits. Don't trade into her: last-hit with the tip of Snip Snip! and stay spaced so you never give her a clean Test of Spirit. The whole early game is just farming, dodging her E, and not getting dragged into her tentacle field — your Q cone is clunky to land on a spaced Illaoi, so settle for safe last-hits over poke.
edits.after: Levels 1-3 are hers and you have to respect it — Illaoi out-stats you on raw base damage, and a landed Test of Spirit (E, 16s at rank 1) rips your spirit out so tentacles spawn and chase you while you have no W and no items to soak the hits. Spacing alone will not save you: Harsh Lesson is a 4s dash that also resets her auto, so she closes the gap herself and the swing wind-up, not the cast, is your tell. Last-hit with the tip of Snip Snip!, dodge the E, and settle for safe last-hits over poke you cannot afford.

edits.before: Levels 4-5 stay dicey — you're a melee with no mist uptime against her field, so keep farming and dodging her E while you wait for 6. Everything flips at 6: Needlework gives you a slow, and your full Q-W-E lets you fight from inside Hallowed Mist on top of her. The mist's armor and MR plus its untargetability to her autos and her E-grab let you ignore her single-target threats and just out-DPS her tentacle slams while Snip Snip! grinds her down. The play is to fight in your own mist, let your passive healing eat through her sustain, and disengage if she slows you onto a fresh tentacle cluster.
edits.after: Levels 4-5 stay dicey — you are a melee with no mist uptime against her field, so keep farming and dodging her 16s E while you wait for 6. Everything flips at 6: Needlework gives you a slow, and your full Q-W-E lets you fight from inside Hallowed Mist on top of her, where her autos and Harsh Lesson cannot target you and you out-DPS the slams. The hard rule is Leap of Faith: it GROUNDS you, so Skip 'n Slash is disabled while it is up. Spend your dash before she ults, never after — once she has, you are staying in that tentacle field whether you like it or not.

edits.before: This is your house. Snip Snip!'s percent-max-HP magic plus its true-damage center ignores the armor and HP she stacks, so the tankier she builds the harder you and your passive shred her — and she has zero escape once you dash onto her. Carry anti-heal to cut the lifesteal she gets off slamming you, fight inside your mist so her autos and E whiff while you DPS, and never let her ult you on a full tentacle field with no escape. Close fights on your terms and her total immobility loses every time.
edits.after: This is your house. Snip Snip!'s percent-max-HP magic plus its true-damage centre ignore the armour and HP she stacks, so the tankier she builds the harder you shred her — and she has zero escape once you dash onto her. Carry Grievous Wounds to cut the lifesteal she gets off slamming you, fight inside your mist so her autos and Harsh Lesson whiff, and never let her Leap of Faith you on a full tentacle field: the grounding takes your dash away and you cannot leave. Close fights on your terms and her total immobility loses every time.

edits.after: With Q+E you poke and reset, but she is ahead until your mist is online — commit only after a 16s Test of Spirit whiffs.

edits.after: At 6 you fight inside Hallowed Mist on top of her: it blanks her autos and Harsh Lesson while Needlework slows and your Q out-DPSes the slams — but Leap of Faith grounds your dash.

notes: Fixes: (1) the chart gave Gwen levels 1, 2 and 3 and made first item even, the reverse of whys[0], whys[1] and whys[5]; corrected to Illaoi/Illaoi/Skill/Skill/Gwen/Gwen/Gwen. (2) The full layer refers to Illaoi as 'he' 19 times against 10 'she'; corrected. (3) Two abilities are missing from the whole page. Harsh Lesson (W) is a 4-second dash that also resets her auto-attack - it is how she closes onto a spaced Gwen and it is the tell that a slam is coming, and the page's entire early plan is 'stay spaced', which W directly defeats. Leap of Faith (R) GROUNDS: while it is active Skip 'n Slash is disabled, so the page's advice to 'disengage if she slows you onto a fresh tentacle cluster' is impossible during her ult - that is the one thing a Gwen must know here and it was absent. (4) No cooldowns: Test of Spirit 16s at rank 1 and Leap of Faith 120s.
